review_locator: PMCID:PMC8151260, Deregulation of the Interleukin-7 Signaling Pathway in Lymphoid Malignancies
primary_title: STAT5 is critical to maintain effector CD8+ T cell responses
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-7-induced Bcl-2 expression in effector CD8+ T cells and impaired induction after STAT5 deletion, supporting a bounded IL-7/STAT5-to-BCL2 output.
limitations_preserved: Promote as an evidence-skipped IL-7-to-BCL2 gene-expression bridge alongside the existing IL7 receptor-complex-to-STAT5 edge; preserve effector CD8+ T-cell and STAT5-dependence boundaries without terminal-TF or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8151260, Deregulation of the Interleukin-7 Signaling Pathway in Lymphoid Malignancies
primary_title: Characterization of interleukin-7-induced changes in tyrosine phosphorylation and c-myc gene expression in normal human T cells
decision_basis: The review-guided primary reports that IL-7 increases c-myc expression and transcription in normal human peripheral-blood T lymphocytes, with kinase-inhibitor sensitivity.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-7-associated MYC gene-transcription bridge; preserve the kinase-dependent primary-response semantics and do not relabel it as STAT5-exclusive or as MYC protein abundance.
